title: RNABL30041_ADHD_rep1
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was extracted with the Qiagen PAXgene blood RNA kit (P/N 762164) using a QIAcube automation system.
extract_protocol_ch1.2: Ribosomal RNA depletion of approximately 0.5-2 ug of total RNA was performed using the Illumina Ribo-Zero Gold kit (#MRZG12324). First strand cDNA synthesis was carried out by initially incubating 7 µL of sample plus water (~30-50 ng RNA) at 95°C for 5 minutes and chilling on ice for 2 minutes. While on ice, 5 µL of 50 ng/µL random hexamers (Invitrogen #51709) and 1 µL of 10 mM dNTP (Invitrogen #Y02256) mix were added to the RNA and the mixture was incubated at 65°C for 5 minutes. While on ice, 4 µL of 5x buffer and 1 µL of 0.1 M DTT were mixed into the solution and incubated at 15°C for 20 minutes. Finally, 1 µL of RNase Inhibitor and 1 µL of 200 U/µL Superscript III Reverse Transcriptase (Invitrogen #18080-044) were added. The following program was run on the thermal cycler: 25°C for 10 minutes, 40°C for 40 minutes, 55°C for 50 minutes, and 85°C for 5 minutes. Upon completion, 1 µL each of 2 U/µL RNase H (Invitrogen #18021-071) and 50 U/µL RNase If (NEB #MO243) were used to digest the RNA strand at 37°C for 30 minutes and subsequently purified using EdgeBio Performa DTR Gel filtration cartridges (#42453). 3’ Poly A tailing was initiated by addition of 4 µL of 10x TdT buffer and 4 µL of 2.5 mM CoCl2 and water to 10 µL of cDNA, denatured at 95 °C for 5 minutes, and snap cooled. Then 250x dATP and 1 µL of 20 U/µL (diluted to 10 U/µL) Terminal Transferase (NEB #M0315) were added and the solution was incubated for 30 minutes at 37°C. Finally, 2 µL of 200 µM ddATP were spiked into the reaction which was incubated at 37°C for 1 hour, and 70°C for 10 minutes to inactivate the enzyme.

data_processing.2: Raw expression was calculated with a custom script: +1 is added if a read occurs inside an exon and +0.5 if read covers exonic junction
data_processing.3: Raw counts were RPKM normalized with a custom script
data_processing.5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: TXT tab-separated file with DGE counts
